title.value: Self-Influence Guided Data Reweighting for Language Model Pre-training
title.justification: The title directly describes the central theme of the paper, which is about using self-influence to guide data reweighting in the context of language model pre-training.
title.quote: Self-Influence Guided Data Reweighting for Language Model Pre-training

extractions.description: This paper presents a method called P RESENCE, which leverages self-influence scores to reweight data samples during the pre-training of language models. The study investigates how varying the importance of data samples based on their self-influence scores can improve the quality and efficiency of language model pre-training. This approach is novel in the domain of pre-training sample reweighting, as it adapts influence functions typically used in supervised learning to the large-scale, unsupervised context of language model training.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on a novel method for pre-training language models by reweighting data samples using self-influence scores. There is no specific connection to environmental sustainability or eco-responsible AI applications.
primary_category.quote: We initiate a study into data reweighting for pretraining...P RESENCE promotes novelty and stability for model pre-training.

primary_sub_category.justification: As with the primary category, the sub-category is not applicable as the paper focuses on methodological advancements in AI rather than eco-responsible applications.
primary_sub_category.quote: P RESENCE is an online and adaptive data reweighting method that uses self-influence scores to weigh samples in a training batch.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper introduces and elaborates on a new methodological approach for improving data sample weighting in pre-training language models, which falls under the broader field of AI methodologies.
new_primary_category.quote: We fill this important gap and propose P RESENCE, a method for jointly reweighting samples by leveraging self-influence (SI) scores as an indicator of sample importance and pre-training.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's specific focus is on the pre-training of language models using a novel sample reweighting strategy guided by self-influence scores.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We then probe their effectiveness for pre-training dataset selection by using them to filter out noisy samples in the pre-training data derived from the web.
